### The Highwaymen — Justice, Pursuit & The End of an Outlaw Era

The Highwaymen (2019) tells the story of former Texas Rangers Frank Hamer and Maney Gault, two veteran lawmen brought out of retirement to track down the notorious criminals Bonnie Parker and Clyde Barrow during the Great Depression.

While the public celebrates Bonnie and Clyde as rebellious folk heroes, their violent crimes continue to leave victims behind. Frustrated by the FBI's limitations and traditional investigative methods, Texas authorities turn to Hamer and Gault, hoping their experience and determination can bring the dangerous duo to justice.

As the investigation unfolds, the two Rangers follow clues, interview witnesses, and travel across several states in pursuit of the fugitives. Facing public fascination with the criminals and a lack of modern investigative technology, Hamer and Gault rely on patience, instinct, and old-fashioned police work to close in on their targets.

The film explores themes of justice, duty, loyalty, and the difference between public legend and reality. It presents the pursuit from the perspective of the lawmen, highlighting the human cost of crime and the difficult decisions required to stop notorious fugitives.

What makes The Highwaymen compelling is watching two experienced Rangers risk everything to end a crime spree that has turned its perpetrators into national celebrities.

💬 While the world turned Bonnie and Clyde into legends, two Texas Rangers were determined to bring their story to an end.

source_details.synopsis: The Highwaymen is a 2019 American period crime thriller film directed by John Lee Hancock and written by John Fusco. The film stars Kevin Costner and Woody Harrelson as Frank Hamer and Maney Gault, two former Texas Rangers who attempt to track down and apprehend notorious criminals Bonnie and Clyde in the 1930s. Kathy Bates, John Carroll Lynch, Kim Dickens, Thomas Mann and William Sadler also star. The film had been in development hell for many years, with producer Casey Silver looking into the project as early as 2005.
